{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module crc32_fixed (
    input wire [7:0] data_in,
    input wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0] data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    // Factor the identical data and low-state columns before the CRC map.
    wire [7:0] mixed;
    assign mixed = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant symbolic simulation of the reflected eight-step CRC map.
    // Each symbolic bit is a mask over mixed, not a runtime state bit.
    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [7:0] s [0:31];
        reg [7:0] feedback_masks [0:7];
        reg [7:0] feedback;
        integer i;
        integer j;
        begin
            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1) begin
                s[j] = 8'b0;
                if (j < 8)
                    s[j] = 8'b1 << j;
            end
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0];
                feedback_masks[i] = feedback;
                for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                    s[j] = s[j+1];
                s[31] = 8'b0;
                for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1) begin
                    if ((32'hedb88320 >> j) & 1'b1)
                        s[j] = s[j] ^ feedback;
                end
            end
            if (index < 32)
                crc_mask = s[index];
            else
                crc_mask = feedback_masks[index-32];
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            wire correction;
            assign correction = ^(mixed & MASK);
            if (n < 24) begin : shifted
                assign state_out[n] = state_in[n+8] ^ correction;
            end else begin : unshifted
                assign state_out[n] = correction;
            end
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n+32);
            assign data_out[n] = ^(mixed & MASK);
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module lfsr #(
    parameter LFSR_WIDTH = 31,
    parameter LFSR_POLY = 31'h10000001,
    parameter LFSR_CONFIG = "FIBONACCI",
    parameter LFSR_FEED_FORWARD = 0,
    parameter REVERSE = 0,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
    parameter STYLE = "AUTO"
)(
    input wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data_in,
    input wire [LFSR_WIDTH-1:0] state_in,
    output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data_out,
    output wire [LFSR_WIDTH-1:0] state_out
);
    crc32_fixed core (
        .data_in(data_in),
        .state_in(state_in),
        .data_out(data_out),
        .state_out(state_out)
    );
endmodule

module crc32_d8 (
    input wire [7:0] data_in,
    input wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0] data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    lfsr #(
        .LFSR_WIDTH(32),
        .LFSR_POLY(32'h04c11db7),
        .LFSR_CONFIG("GALOIS"),
        .LFSR_FEED_FORWARD(0),
        .REVERSE(1),
        .DATA_WIDTH(8),
        .STYLE("REDUCTION")
    ) core (
        .data_in(data_in),
        .state_in(state_in),
        .data_out(data_out),
        .state_out(state_out)
    );
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The previous implementation independently reduced masks over 40 raw input bits. Its mapped critical paths contained input buffering followed by deep, reconvergent parity logic, reaching 0.99 ns.",
  "rewrite": "Explicitly factor data_in XOR state_in[7:0] into eight shared signals. Apply the reflected CRC linear map to those signals, then XOR in the independently shifted upper state bits. Constant symbolic simulation produces both the state correction masks and the exact eight feedback-output masks; the simulation loop creates no runtime serial CRC chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement over 0.99 ns from smaller parity cones and reduced raw-input fanout. A reasonable target is approximately 0.75–0.90 ns, but mapped timing and electrical compliance require evaluation; these are estimates, not measured results.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Eight explicit input XORs replace repeated data/state parity contributions across output cones. Area is expected to decrease relative to 2413.5648 um2 and remain below 2752.6400 um2. Shared mixed signals may require buffering; actual area, slew, and capacitance must be checked after mapping.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Specialized to the assessed crc32_d8 instance and its exact Galois, reflected CRC32 configuration. All 40 input bits remain arbitrary. Upper state bits contribute through the exact eight-position shift, with no initialization or final inversion. data_out contains the actual feedback sequence, including polynomial-induced interactions, rather than merely the mixed input byte. Module interfaces and declared parameter defaults are retained; other lfsr parameter configurations are not implemented by this specialized helper. No storage, latency, assumptions, or undefined outputs are introduced."
}
